description: Spot-only adaptive grid strategy inspired by Gridora: select volatile liquid allowlisted tokens, avoid falling knives, size the grid band from recent volatility, only trade fee-clearing levels, protect capital with inventory/drawdown/profit guards, and flatten to USDT when risk breaks.

universe_selection.score_formula: score = min(range_cap_pct, range_24h_pct) * range_weight + clipped_7d_change + min(liquidity_bonus_cap, volume_24h_usd / liquidity_bonus_usd_per_point)
selection_logic: Only trade tokens from the allowlist against a USD stable quote.
Reject tokens down more than 8% over 7 days to avoid falling knives.
Reject tokens with known 24h range below 1.5% because the grid may not fill.
Rank by volatility first, then relative strength, then liquidity.
Allocate more weight to the highest-ranked token, but do not put all capital into one market.

recenter.reason: If price leaves the band, cancel old grid and relay around the new mid.

fee_aware_spacing.rule: Reduce grid level count until the smallest adjacent spacing is greater than max(round_trip_fee_floor_bps, preset.extra_min_spacing_bps). If even a 2-level grid cannot clear fees, do not trade.

range.name: Range Grid
range.use_when: Market is choppy/ranging with no strong trend.

trend_long.name: Trend Grid Long
trend_long.use_when: Positive momentum without extreme greed. Spot bot only opens buy ladder; sells are paired take-profits.

tight_scalp.name: Tight Scalp Grid
tight_scalp.use_when: Calm low-volatility range, price near mid, enough range to clear fees.

wide_defensive.name: Wide Defensive Grid
wide_defensive.use_when: High volatility, uncertainty, squeeze risk, or market is dangerous but not fully halted.

flat.name: Flat / Halt
flat.use_when: Market too dangerous, drawdown risk elevated, token no longer qualifies, or no fee-clearing edge.
flat.action: Sell to USDT and place no new orders.

grid_execution_rules.initial_orders: Place BUY orders below mid and SELL orders above mid. For spot-only long-bias mode, place only BUY ladder first; paired SELL take-profits appear after buys fill.

paired_order_logic.on_buy_fill: Place a SELL one grid level higher for the same size.
paired_order_logic.on_sell_fill: Place a BUY one grid level lower for the same size.

circuit_breaker.on_trip: Cancel all orders, sell inventory back to USDT, halt new trades until next safe cycle.

profit_guard.logic: Once total PnL peaks after exceeding 5% of margin, flatten if PnL gives back 40% or more from the peak.

account_guard.purpose: Portfolio-level kill switch, separate from single-grid drawdown.
account_guard.on_trip: Flatten all positions to USDT and stop.

allowlist_guard.rule: Never trade a token outside the approved allowlist.

steps: Read market data for allowlisted tokens.
Select top volatile, liquid, non-collapsing markets.
Classify regime: range, trend_long, tight_scalp, wide_defensive, or flat.
Build adaptive grid around current mid price.
Check circuit breaker, profit guard, account guard, and allowlist.
Place, cancel, or replace grid orders.
After fills, place paired order one level away.
Recalculate whether to continue, recenter, rotate token, or flatten.

ikqf_status_labels.decision_flat: FLAT IN USDT — RISK OR EDGE FAILED

important_note: This JSON describes the strategy logic. IKQF must have code that reads this file and implements grid orders, paired fills, adaptive bands, scoring, and guardrails. A JSON file alone will not make the existing bot execute a grid unless the backend strategy loader supports these fields.
